note: OpenClaw is a gateway, not a coding agent: it launches Claude Code, Codex or opencode as child processes. The fetch hook catches the gateway own calls, which read no documented base-URL variable; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and OPENAI_BASE_URL are set for the agents it spawns, which inherit this environment and do read them. harness_versions is null: written from the published package and README, not pinned to a release.
